title:
Gets values from action payload or current pageParams and optionally application state
uses these values as pageParams to redirect or open new tab to url that contains pageParams.
Payload should receive the following values:
  url: The url to redirect to. The pageParams in the url should have this format: "{{pageParamId}}"
  pageParams: An array of pageParams to use. Each entry should have the following fields
    pageParamId: the pageParamId whose value is being set.
    value: If set, the pageParamId will be set to this value
    path: If this field is set and value is NOT set, this path will be used to get the value from
      either the action payload or the current page's pageParams.
  appStateParams: An array of application state params to use. Each entry should have the following fields
    pageParamId: the pageParamId whose value is being set.
    appStateId: the application state id from which the value is being retrieved.
    path: the path used to get the value from the application state.
name: RedirectWithPageParamsEpic
